tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.10.16
§ Adonijah = "my lord is Jehovah"
1) fourth son of David and Solomon's rival for the throne
2) Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
3) a chief of the people who co-operated with Nehemiah

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Adonijah, the name of three Israelites
strongs_1890.derivation: original (prolonged) אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ ; from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H3050 (יָהּ); lord (i.e. worshipper) of Jah;
